name: Lyon
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Lyon metropolitan area (France), from Lyon-Saint Exupery airport to Tassin-la-Demi-Lune and from Rillieux-la-Pape to Saint-Priest. 204k+ OSM buildings (binary format), 736k+ commuters with demand built from real INSEE census data. Lyon-Saint Exupery airport with runways and taxiways. The Rhone and Saone rivers fully modelled with depth data. Protomaps basemap with water, parks and forests.
data_source: INSEE Filosofi 2021 (donnees carroyees, revenus et population) - INSEE Recensement de la population 2021, mobilites professionnelles - OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - Overture Maps Foundation (buildings)
